L. VANKOUGHNET,
Deputy Superintendent-General of Indian Affairs.

John McGirr, Clerk of Statistics,
Department of Indian Affairs.
OTTAWA, 30th June, 1892.

[Note. - The large decrease in the population over last year is accounted for by the fact that the department has only
obtained partially correct census returns from the Church Authorities in the Peace River, Athabasca, Mackenzie,
Nelson and Churchill River Districts, and that the census of the Nomadic Indians in the Provinces of Ontario and
Quebec has been amended as far as possible in accordance with the Dominion Census of 1891.]
